title: Billy River Adventure
moral: Courage and thinking carefully help solve problems.

scenes.summary: Billy and Dusty explore the plains together.
scenes.text: Billy rides his horse Dusty across the sunny plains and loves to explore.
scenes.image_prompt: boy riding horse across green plains smiling, colorful cartoon children's book style
scenes.story: Billy was a young cowboy who loved riding his horse Dusty across the sunny plains. One day he had a mission to find a safe place to cross a big river so people could bring supplies. Billy and Dusty rode along the river carefully. They saw ducks crossing at a calm spot. Billy tested the water with a stick and saw it was safe. He returned to town and told everyone. The townsfolk followed him and crossed safely. Everyone cheered for Billy. Billy felt proud and happy. He knew courage and smart thinking helped him succeed.
